BiblicalUsage: Rammiy is a Ramite, an Aramaean — a man of Aram. Ahaziah went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead, 'and the Syrians smote Joram' — the Ramites, the men of Aram, wounded the king of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the wound at Ramoth-gilead is the hinge of two kingdoms' fall: Joram went home wounded, and Jehu was anointed in his place.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Hazael, King of Syria
